text: Which of the following sets is uncountable?
choices: The set of all finite subsets of ℕ
explanation: Cantor's theorem gives |ℕ| < |𝒫(ℕ)|, and in fact |𝒫(ℕ)| = |ℝ|. The other three are countable: ℚ and ℤ×ℤ by zigzag enumeration, and the finite subsets of ℕ as a countable union of countable sets.
